$:set -euo pipefail
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
for p in terminal/AGENTS.md terminal/README.md terminal/tasks/AGENTS.md terminal/tasks/README.md terminal/tasks/fishFry/AGENTS.md terminal/tasks/fishFry/README.md;do if test -f "$p";then echo "APPLICABLE $p";cat "$p";exit 2;fi;done
BASE='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean_upper_right_724x724_arrow_removed_opencv_base.png'
SOBEL='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_upper_right_724x724_arrow_removed_sobel_x.png'
test -f "$BASE" && test -f "$SOBEL"
test "$(sha256sum "$BASE" | awk '{print $1}')" = '7e07015264f782664407afe6ad3bc852b370651e4020b4bb524910f284dfb14e'
test "$(sha256sum "$SOBEL" | awk '{print $1}')" = '50a9d08fc4d88831b06523aced7b75e69d845cf1db0e276aeb20f3fbabbbf944'
python3 -m venv /tmp/fishfry_rim_diag_v1
/tmp/fishfry_rim_diag_v1/bin/python -m pip -q install opencv-python-headless scipy
/tmp/fishfry_rim_diag_v1/bin/python - <<'PY'
import cv2,numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import map_coordinates,gaussian_filter1d
a=cv2.imread('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean_upper_right_724x724_arrow_removed_opencv_base.png',cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE).astype(float)
s=cv2.imread('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_upper_right_724x724_arrow_removed_sobel_x.png',cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE).astype(float)
assert a.shape==s.shape==(724,724)
origin=(0.0,724.0)
for angle in [8,12,20,30,40,50,60,70,78,82]:
 t=np.deg2rad(angle);r=np.arange(635.,749.,.5)
 x=origin[0]+r*np.cos(t);y=origin[1]-r*np.sin(t)
 mask=(x>=0)&(x<=723)&(y>=0)&(y<=723)
 r,x,y=r[mask],x[mask],y[mask]
 inten=map_coordinates(a,[y,x],order=1,mode='nearest')
 sobel=map_coordinates(s,[y,x],order=1,mode='nearest')
 smooth=gaussian_filter1d(inten,2.)
 dr=np.gradient(smooth,r)
 ix=np.where((r>=650)&(r<=735))[0]
 cand=ix[np.argsort(dr[ix])[-5:][::-1]] if len(ix) else []
 print('ANGLE',angle,'STRONGEST_POS_GRAD',[(round(float(r[k]),1),round(float(dr[k]),2),round(float(inten[k]),1),round(float(sobel[k]),1)) for k in cand])
 print('SAMPLES',angle,[(rr,round(float(map_coordinates(a,[[origin[1]-rr*np.sin(t)],[origin[0]+rr*np.cos(t)]],order=1,mode='nearest')[0]),1)) for rr in [660,670,680,690,700,710,720,730] if (origin[0]+rr*np.cos(t)<724 and origin[1]-rr*np.sin(t)>=0 and origin[1]-rr*np.sin(t)<724)])
PY
